updater.title: Automatic updates

updater.diskLow: Only {free} is free on the disk that holds Docker. Updates wait until at least {required} is free, and a full disk can stop the database. Remove unused images with docker image prune or shorten the log retention.
updater.outcome: {outcome, select, up_to_date {Up to date} available {Update found} updated {Updated} rolled_back {Rolled back} failed {Failed} pinned {Pinned tag} other {Unknown}}, {when}
updater.pinned: The image tag {tag} is pinned to one release, so the updater never replaces it. Set LLMHUB_TAG to latest or dev to receive updates.
updater.issue: {issue, select, docker_unavailable {The updater cannot reach the Docker socket.} no_project {The updater does not run inside a Docker Compose project.} no_targets {No running container carries the label llmhub.updater.target=true.} mixed_images {The labeled containers run different image references.} unsupported_image {The app container does not reference its image by repository and tag.} registry_unreachable {The image registry could not be reached.} other {The updater reported a problem.}}
updater.autoHint: The updater checks for a new image every five minutes and restarts LLM Hub with it. Changes apply immediately.
updater.autoPinned: Has no effect while the image tag is pinned.
updater.autoChanged: {enabled, select, true {Automatic updates turned on} other {Automatic updates turned off}}
updater.updateDescription: The updater downloads the newest image and restarts LLM Hub. Running requests get up to 25 seconds to finish, new API requests are asked to retry shortly, and the console reconnects once the new version is healthy. If startup fails, the updater restores the previous services when safe. Database migration failures may require manual recovery.
updater.requested: {action, select, check {The updater checks for a new image.} update {The updater installs the update.} other {Request sent.}}
updater.noticeBody: An updater is connected to this server. Turn on automatic updates to install new LLM Hub images within five minutes of their release. LLM Hub restarts briefly for each update.
updater.dashboardDescription: Current activity and the five most recent completed update runs.
updater.serviceProgress: {completed, number, integer} of {total, number, integer} services ready
updater.elapsed: Started {total, number, integer} s ago · Current phase: {phase, number, integer} s
updater.queued: {action, select, check {Check requested; waiting for the updater to accept it.} update {Update requested; waiting for the updater to accept it.} other {Request queued.}}
updater.staleProgress: Last known status. Live progress is unavailable until the connection returns. A brief interruption is expected while the app restarts; this does not confirm success or failure.
updater.phaseHint: {state, select, idle {No update step is running.} checking {Checking the installed services and looking for a new image.} pulling {Downloading the image. Existing services are still running.} recreating {Stopping and replacing the current services. The app may briefly be unavailable.} verifying {Waiting for all replacement services to become healthy. Startup can take several minutes.} rolling_back {The update failed. Restoring the previous services together.} failed {The update did not complete. Check the result below before trying again.} other {Waiting for a status report.}}
updater.historyEmpty: No completed runs have been recorded yet. Older updaters may only report the last result.
updater.downloadBytes: {known, select, true {{downloaded} of {total} downloaded} other {{downloaded} downloaded · Total size unknown}}
updater.downloadLayers: {total, plural, =0 {Waiting for layer information} other {{completed, number, integer} of # layers ready}}
updater.cachedLayers: Ready layers include cached layers, which need no download. Byte counts describe the current image download.
updater.startup: {startup, select, migrating {Database migrations are running. Services will start after they finish; this can take several minutes.} migration_failed {Database migration failed. The update cannot finish. An administrator must review the migration failure before retrying.} starting {Migrations have finished. Waiting for the application to start and become healthy.} manual_recovery {Manual recovery is required. Automatic rollback cannot safely complete. An administrator must check the database migration and service state before restarting or retrying the update.} other {Waiting for startup status.}}
